title: Probing T-cell response by sequence-based probabilistic modeling
summary: Restricted Boltzmann Machine models of TCR sequences and clone abundance identify antigen-specific motifs and distinguish responsive from generic clones; held-out and leave-one-out validation plus in-vitro antigen-response datasets support a specific T-cell-response modeling result.
